name: Renault Fuego GTX
description: The Renault Fuego is a sporty coupe produced by French automaker Renault from 1980 to 1992. The GTX variant featured a 2.0L engine with 110 hp, distinctive wedge-shaped styling, and front-wheel drive. Known for its aerodynamic design and European sports coupe character, the Fuego offered a blend of performance and practicality during the 1980s.
author: ASW (Assetto Street Wheels)
